build_energy_term: build a custom EnergyTerm subclass that computes a scoring metric on a FoldingResult for protein design optimization
create_symmetry_ring: create a SymmetryRing energy term to penalize asymmetric protomer arrangement in a multimeric protein folding result
compute_hydrophobic_score: compute the ratio of surface-exposed hydrophobic atoms in a biotite AtomArray to evaluate protein folding quality
compute_c_rmsd: compute the coordinate RMSD between two AtomArrays by superimposing one onto the other and measuring per-atom deviation
compute_d_rmsd: compute the distance matrix RMSD between two AtomArrays by comparing all pairwise inter-atomic distances
